purpose: Form INC-32 is used at the time of incorporation of a One Person Company to include the name and nomination details of the nominee, along with the nominee's written consent as a declaration, or to mention the particulars of a maximum of three proposed directors for the allotment of a Director Identification Number. The provided text also references Form INC-32 (SPICe+) for One Person Company incorporation and Form INC-32 (SPICe) for director particulars.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: At the time of incorporation of the company
steps: Obtain prior written consent from the person to be nominated as the nominee for the One Person Company.
Mention the name of the nominated person in the memorandum of the One Person Company.
Fill in the nomination details along with the consent of the nominee as a declaration in Form INC-32 (SPICe+).
File the Form with the Registrar at the time of incorporation of the company along with the required fee, e-memorandum, and e-articles.
Alternatively, mention the particulars of a maximum of three proposed directors not having an approved DIN in Form INC-32 (SPICe) for DIN allotment.
checklist: Prior written consent of the nominated person for a One Person Company
Nominee name to be included in the memorandum
Fee as provided in the Companies (Registration offices and fees) Rules, 2014
e-memorandum and e-articles of the company
Particulars of up to three proposed directors if applying for DIN allotment through the form
watch: Ensure the nominee's prior written consent is obtained before filing the form.
